caption: A car reverses slowly into a lamp post, and its rear bumper dents inward and stays dented after it pulls forward.

sa.check: A car reverses slowly toward a lamp post.
The rear bumper hits the post.
It stays dented after the car pulls forward.
The impact comes first, then the dent, then the car pulls away.

pc.expect: The dent forms at the point of contact at the moment of impact, and the post does not bend.
pc.fail: No dent forms; or the post bends; or the bumper shatters.

pc.expect: The dent remains when the car moves away.
pc.fail: It springs back; or the dent vanishes; or the dent is there before contact.

pc.expect: The car stops at the post and does not pass into it.
pc.fail: It passes through the post; or the post passes through the car; or the car sinks into the road.
It moves; or vanishes; or leans and stays leaning.

pc.expect: One car and one post keep their number.
pc.fail: The car duplicates; or the post vanishes; or the car turns into another vehicle.

pc.expect: The car's colour and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the post changes; or the street rearranges.
